accused_religion.reason: Religion is not mentioned in the judgment.

victim_age.reason: The judgment gives no age for the victim.

victim_caste.reason: Caste is not mentioned in the judgment.

victim_religion.reason: Religion is not mentioned in the judgment.

offence_category.correct_value: Cruelty by husband (s.498A IPC) and abetment of suicide (s.306 IPC)
offence_category.reason: No culpable homicide charge; the offences are cruelty and abetment of suicide.

statutory_provisions.reason: Sections 498A and 306 IPC are the provisions applied.

weapon.reason: No weapon is identified; the death was by hanging and kerosene was used by the victim.

evidence_type.correct_value: Post-mortem report (PW-4); seizure of documents and material objects; witness testimony; documentary evidence of leave and mediation
evidence_type.quote: PW-4 conducted autopsy and submitted the post-mortem report
evidence_type.reason: Post-mortem and seizure are mentioned, but 'circumstantial' is not characterised by the judgment.

confession.reason: No confession is mentioned; the accused denied the incriminating evidence.

aggravating_circumstances.reason: The judgment does not expressly identify aggravating circumstances.

mitigating_circumstances.correct_value: Appellant visited India only four times in 1988-1996; he made mediation efforts; wife suicided on the mediation day
mitigating_circumstances.quote: The appellant also appears to have taken efforts for mediation
mitigating_circumstances.reason: The judgment expressly states mitigating circumstances, which the value wrongly marks as not stated.

trial_court_outcome.correct_value: Convicted under s.498A (two years RI, fine Rs.5,000, default one year) and s.306 (seven years RI, fine Rs.50,000, default three years); sentences ran consecutively
trial_court_outcome.quote: For the offence punishable under Section 306 IPC, the trial court sentenced him to undergo rigorous imprisonment for seven years
trial_court_outcome.reason: Covers only the s.306 sentence; omits the s.498A sentence and the consecutive direction.

high_court_outcome.reason: High Court confirmed conviction and sentence of all accused, as stated in the judgment.

final_outcome.correct_value: Convicted; Supreme Court partly allowed the appeal and directed the sentences to run concurrently
final_outcome.quote: Partly allowing the appeal, the Court
final_outcome.reason: Conviction is correct but omits that the appeal was partly allowed and sentences made concurrent.

offence_finally_established.correct_value: Cruelty by husband (s.498A IPC) and abetment of suicide (s.306 IPC)
offence_finally_established.quote: confirmed the conviction of the appellant/ 1st accused under Sections 498A and 306 IPC
offence_finally_established.reason: Culpable homicide was not an offence in this case; the established offences are ss.498A and 306 IPC.

imprisonment_type.reason: Both sentences are fixed-term rigorous imprisonment.

imprisonment_years.correct_value: 7 years (s.306); 2 years (s.498A); ordered to run concurrently
imprisonment_years.reason: 7 years is the s.306 term, but the 2-year s.498A term is not reflected.

fine_rs.quote: to pay a fine of Rs.50,000/-
fine_rs.reason: Rs.50,000 is the s.306 fine; the Rs.5,000 fine for s.498A is omitted.

neutral_facts.reason: Facts track the judgment, framed as allegations, and do not reveal the outcome.

offence_severity.reason: Describes the sentences imposed under ss.498A and 306 IPC accurately.

attempt_completion.reason: The victim's suicide was completed by hanging.

physical_harm.correct_value: Lillikutty died by suicide by hanging; the torture and harassment are the prosecution's allegation
physical_harm.quote: The allegation levelled is that in the matrimonial house, the appellant/1st accused and other accused ill-treated and tortured Lillikutty
physical_harm.reason: Presents prosecution allegations of torture as established fact.

number_of_offences.reason: Two offences under ss.498A and 306 IPC, with convictions confirmed.

financial_property_loss.reason: Judgment is silent on property loss; 'Not applicable' asserts a conclusion it does not state.

premeditation_planning.reason: Premeditation is not discussed in the judgment.

motive.correct_value: Alleged matrimonial cruelty and harassment; differences between husband and wife settled through mediation
motive.quote: The allegation levelled is that in the matrimonial house, the appellant/1st accused and other accused ill-treated and tortured Lillikutty
motive.reason: The judgment identifies the alleged motive as matrimonial ill-treatment and differences; 'Not identified' is wrong.

key_evidence_accepted.reason: Court relied on evidence of four visits to India and mediation scheduled on the day of suicide.

witness_credibility.reason: The judgment does not assess witness credibility; it addresses sentencing discretion only.

trial_duration.correct_value: Offence period 1988-1996 (suicide 23.02.1996); High Court judgment 27.11.2013; Supreme Court decision 11.11.2014; trial court date not stated
trial_duration.quote: From the Judgment & Order dated 27.11.2013 of the High Court of Kerala
trial_duration.reason: 27.11.2013 is the High Court judgment date, not the trial judgment; trial date is not given.
